item.title: Taxi rank upgrade promises shade, water and safer crossings for commuters

article.title: Taxi rank upgrade promises shade, water and safer crossings for commuters | Sample News
article.excerpt: Work starts in January on a rank used by 40,000 people a day.

lead.caption: Commuters queue in the midday heat. (Sample photo)

blocks.html: Commuters at the city's busiest taxi rank will get covered walkways, drinking-water points and two raised pedestrian crossings when construction starts in January, the council said on Sunday.
blocks.text: Commuters at the city's busiest taxi rank will get covered walkways, drinking-water points and two raised pedestrian crossings when construction starts in January, the council said on Sunday.

blocks.html: The rank handles about 40,000 people on a weekday. A survey published last year found that most waited more than 20 minutes in full sun during summer.
blocks.text: The rank handles about 40,000 people on a weekday. A survey published last year found that most waited more than 20 minutes in full sun during summer.

blocks.html: We are not asking for luxury. We are asking for shade and a safe way across the road.
blocks.text: We are not asking for luxury. We are asking for shade and a safe way across the road.

items.html: Roofed walkways along both loading lanes
items.text: Roofed walkways along both loading lanes

items.html: Six drinking-water points and new public toilets
items.text: Six drinking-water points and new public toilets

items.html: Two raised crossings with traffic lights
items.text: Two raised crossings with traffic lights

blocks.caption: An artist's impression of the new walkways. (Sample image)

blocks.html: The project is budgeted at R48 million and should take 14 months. Taxis will keep running during the work, with loading moved to the eastern lanes in stages.
blocks.text: The project is budgeted at R48 million and should take 14 months. Taxis will keep running during the work, with loading moved to the eastern lanes in stages.

blocks.html: Residents can comment on the plans at the ward office until 30 November.
blocks.text: Residents can comment on the plans at the ward office until 30 November.
